info.title: Circuvent Device API
info.summary: Read device state, send commands, and receive signed webhooks from Circuvent smart-home hardware.
info.description:
The public API for the Circuvent control plane — the same one our own console and mobile apps use.

Authenticate with an API key created in Console → Settings → Developer. Keys are scoped; a scope does not imply any other scope. Full guide at https://circuvent.com/developers

tags.name: ANPR
tags.description: Number-plate reads, the vehicle register and site occupancy. Scoped separately from telemetry: a plate log is a record of which vehicles came to a property, about people who are not the account holder.

get.description: Scopes, webhook events and the endpoint list. No authentication required — use it to confirm the base URL is reachable before debugging a credential.
Returns the account the key belongs to and the scopes it actually holds. The fastest way to diagnose a 403.

patch.summary: Rename, assign a room, or set favourite

post.description: The body is forwarded to the device unchanged; the accepted fields are defined by that product's firmware. Responds 202 — the broker has accepted the command for delivery, not that the relay has closed. Observe the result by re-reading the device or taking a webhook.

get.description: Buckets hourly for windows up to 48 hours, daily beyond that. kWh is the integral of the averaged metric across the buckets.

post.description: Actions naming a device the caller no longer owns are skipped rather than failing the whole scene, and are listed in `skipped`.
Every device the rule names — in the trigger as well as the actions — must belong to the calling account, or the request is refused with 403 device_not_owned.

sunsetLights.summary: Switch a light on at 18:30 on weekdays

leakAlert.summary: Notify when a sensor reports a leak

get.description: One row per sighting. The capture image is advertised rather than inlined: a page of 100 reads stays a few KB, and most rows are never opened.

parameters.name: plate
parameters.description: Normalised on the way in, so 'KA 01 AB 1234' and 'ka-01-ab-1234' both work.

votes.description: Frames of the burst that produced this plate.

samples.description: Frames the recogniser was run on.

reason.description: Why an unrecognised read failed: no_recogniser, no_plate, invalid_format, timeout, provider_error.

direction.description: Null when the lane's direction could not be resolved — never guessed.

get.summary: The capture a plate was read from
get.description: Real image/jpeg rather than base64 in JSON, so it caches and can be pointed at directly. Images expire before the metadata does — see ANPR_IMAGE_RETENTION_DAYS.
One row per distinct plate rather than per sighting. 'How often does this van come, and is it here now' cannot be answered by paging /v1/plates.

inside.description: Has an open visit: arrived and not yet seen leaving.

get.description: 404 rather than an empty profile when the plate has never been seen — 'came zero times' reads like a working answer to what is actually a typo.

parameters.name: plate
parameters.description: Normalised on the way in; spacing and dashes do not matter.

status.description: Gate cameras miss reads. entry_missed and exit_missed are normal states, not errors — pairing resynchronises at the next clean read.

staySeconds.description: Null, never 0, when a read was missed. A fabricated duration is worse than an absent one for anything billed or audited.

get.summary: How full the site is right now
get.description: Counted from open visits, never tallied — a running total is biased permanently by one missed read. Capacity is reported, never enforced: the gate still opens for an allowed vehicle when the site is full.

capacity.description: Null when capacity is not managed — different from zero.

post.summary: Put a plate on a list
post.description: The plate is validated and corrected by the same analyser a camera read goes through, so a rule and a read of the same vehicle can never be different strings. Deny wins over allow.

deviceId.description: Null applies the rule to every ANPR camera on the account.

validTo.description: For a contractor or a visitor.

409.description: That plate is already on a list for this scope.

delete.summary: Remove a plate from its list

post.description: POSTed to the URL you register in Console → Settings → Developer. Verify `X-Circuvent-Signature` before trusting the body: it is `t=<unix>,v1=<hex>` where v1 is HMAC-SHA256 of `"<t>.<raw body>"` using your webhook signing secret. Reject deliveries whose timestamp is more than a few minutes old. We wait 5 s for a 2xx; 20 consecutive failures disable the webhook. Redirects are not followed.

id.description: Unique delivery id — use it to de-duplicate.

ApiKeyAuth.description: An API key from Console → Settings → Developer. `X-API-Key: <key>` is accepted as an alternative header. Keys are refused from a browser origin unless that origin is registered on the key.

DeviceId.name: id
DeviceId.description: The device id, as shown in the console and used in its MQTT topics.

state.description: Whatever the firmware last published. Keys vary by device type — e.g. a four-channel hub reports power, power2, power3, power4.

field.description: State field to watch, for type=state.

at.description: HH:MM for type=time, evaluated in IST.

days.description: Day filter for time triggers. 0 = Sunday. Omit to run daily.

error.description: Human-readable. Wording may change — do not match on it.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Branch on this.

granted.description: On insufficient_scope: the scopes the key holds.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked key. `code` is one of key_invalid, key_expired, key_revoked, key_blocked.

Forbidden.description: The key is valid but lacks the required scope (insufficient_scope) or was used from a disallowed browser origin (origin_not_allowed).

NotFound.description: No such resource, or it belongs to another account. Returned instead of 403 so an id cannot be confirmed to exist.

RateLimited.description: More than 600 requests in a minute for this key. RateLimit-* headers describe the window.
